answer: The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. The sable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the knoll.
